comparison.objective: Open a locker whose door supports a leaning case, capture the case, and place it upright on a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Support-transition planning, guarded opening, bimanual capture, and upright transport.
comparison.success_condition: Case is never tipped or dropped and ends upright, stable, released, and fully on the mat.
comparison.reason: This is another support-transition task, but it tests interception of one leaning rigid payload as a door moves. The candidate tests micron-scale-like interface continuity during constrained sliding and containment of many mobile rolling elements.
